note: MOCK BMS data: each day copies the closest 2018–19 day for this building (same weekday or holiday, nearest temperature and rain), ±3% noise. Weather is real (Open-Meteo archive).

presets.label: Cool snap · Jan 2026
presets.edge: Coolest days of the year (8–11 Jan, daily mean ~24 °C, lows 18 °C). The inputs include the New Year holidays.

presets.label: Hot spell · Apr 2026
presets.edge: Hottest days of the year (up to 38 °C): hot-day rule and earlier starts. Chakri Day (6 Apr) is in the inputs.

presets.label: Songkran · Apr 2026
presets.edge: Three public holidays (13–15 Apr), office closed. Back to work on Thu 16 Apr with holiday inputs.

presets.label: Storm & flooding · Sep 2026
presets.edge: 124 mm of rain on Fri 25 Sep and heavy rain to the 28th, about 3x the wettest training day. Two zones' meters were offline on 19–20 Sep, so they fall back to the typical week.
